notes.title: Announcing a brand new adult RPG soon
notes.content:
Wishlist Deadrock Redemption now for a 15% Launch Discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753270/Deadrock_Redemption/

Our partners at Entropy Digital have just announced a brand new adult NSFW open world RPG called 'Deadrock Redemption'. It proves to be a landmark adult RPG featuring a 3D western-themed world and all new sexy characters!

Here's is the official press release of the new game announcement:
Embark on an epic journey into the heart of the Wild West with "Deadrock Redemption," an open-world RPG that seamlessly blends captivating storytelling, deep character interactions voiced with professional actors, and an expansive 3D world waiting to be explored.

Open-World Adventure
Immerse yourself in the vast and atmospheric landscapes of the Wild West. From the dusty streets of Deadrock to the untamed wilderness beyond, every corner of the open-world map is ripe for exploration. Uncover hidden secrets, encounter dynamic wildlife, and traverse a diverse terrain that reacts to the choices you make.

Deep Character Relationships
Forge bonds with a cast of compelling characters, each with their own unique stories and motivations. Engage in meaningful conversations, make choices that impact relationships, and witness the evolution of these characters as they face the challenges of life in the unforgiving West. Your decisions will shape the destiny of Deadrock.

Exciting Story-Driven Quests
Become a part of the gripping narrative as you take on story-driven quests that unfold in response to your actions. From uncovering the town's dark secrets to facing off against ruthless outlaws, every quest is a stepping stone in an overarching tale of survival, redemption, and the fight for justice. Each quest giving character is voiced by professional actors that add complete immersion to your story.

Dynamic Gameplay
"Deadrock Redemption" offers a dynamic blend of combat, exploration, and decision-making. Hone your skills as a gunslinger, and choose your approach to conflicts – be it through diplomacy, intimidation, or sheer brute force. The game adapts to your choices, providing a unique experience for every player.

notes.title: DragonStone Content Update v1.011
notes.content:
This minor post release content update v1.011 adds 2 new movies, including a transition outro for the new and improved prologue illustration sequence, as well as a new Misty intro movie that plays in the King's Chamber when Misty is first introduced. 

Along with the added content videos, we applies a few fixes to typos and various clean up for playback in transitions from scenes, as well as fixing a replay bug where the first masturabtion scene with Myranda would keep playing if you kept going back to her house before you visited the borderlands.

notes.title: DragonStone Patch v1.011
notes.content: This minor patch fixes a bug found in Castle Balfor where if the player immediately enters the Ladymaids Chambers, the story skips ahead and advances to the encounter with Myranda and Kylara. Now players will see the proper flow of the Ladymaids entering the King's Bedchamber

notes.title: Mac OS launch updated
notes.content: We did not have the Mac OS launch command updated correctly and it was trying to launch the Windows version of the game for MAC users. This error has been corrected with the correct launch setting so that MAC OS users should now be able to easily launch the game out of the Steam Client.

notes.title: Post Launch Tweak Patch v1.009
notes.content:
You have spoken and we have heard you. We've been listening to the community and appreciate that you hated the intro prologue in that style and felt that it did not accurately represent the quality of the rest of the game. 

Update v1.09 adds new high resolution final Illustration prologue selection that now allows players to choose a completely new intro prologue that was created by our in house background artist using the original images as reference.

The new sequence of all new images now more accurately fits the high quality style and look of the rest of our game. We always intended to create a unique and visually stunning intro sequence to help players understand the lore of Valtoria, and now we have something at launch that we are happy to share with you.

notes.title: DragonStone Release patch v1.008
notes.content: This is a minor release day patch for some blurry images that have been improved as well as several spell errors that have been corrected.

notes.title: Dragonstone is now available today on Steam for PC and Mac systems
notes.content:
The wait is over! We're very happy to announce that the dark fantasy NSFW visual novel, Dragonstone releases today on Steam! We've been adding tons of AAA content to the final build to get players the most engrossing and entertaining fantasy story that we can produce. 

In the vein of other fantasy epics, you can expect all types of friends and foes to be included in this new visual novel in the style of other games featuring detailed 3D rendering, still and high quality full frame 3D animations with no part censored or blurred out. 

As we mentioned earlier, we're also releasing the game with a complete set of Steam Achievements at launch. This will be awarded as you play through the game normally and explore all areas of the maps of the Kingdom of Valoria. We hope that you will enjoy this new work from NuWave studios and look forward to your feedback.

notes.title: DragonStone to include Steam Achievements at Launch
notes.content:
There have been multiple inquires to our development team if we will, in fact, be including Steam Achievements with the DragonStone visual novel launch. We're happy to announce that we will in fact be launching with over a dozen Steam Achievements, with more added after launch. 

We'll be introducing other features and additional content as the game rolls out so be sure to check back with the latest developments and be sure to leave us great feedback if your enjoying the game.
